# rmux 0.1.26
Clearer text hover feedback and better-spaced context menus.
- Show the I-beam cursor over visible terminal text, including wide characters, while blank cells and terminal padding retain the arrow. Actionable links keep the hand pointer; terminal selection gestures are unchanged. - Show the I-beam cursor in editable text fields. - Give workspace and terminal-tab context menus more room around their headings, consistent row line heights, and straight section dividers separated from rounded selection backgrounds. - Adjust menu scrolling limits to accommodate the taller headers in small windows. Shared browser-demo menus receive the same spacing improvements.
## Downloads
Signed and notarized macOS Apple Silicon DMG and ZIP, Linux x86-64 tarball, and Windows x86-64 ZIP. macOS updates use Sparkle. All release builds run on GitHub.
Validation: desktop check and debug build passed; both context menus were visually checked in an isolated native preview. Native Windows runtime validation remains deferred.
